text:
sam: quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime Q&A. two things I want clarified: (a) what happens when a kernel switch is suggested during a high-throughput spike, and (b) how should teams tune batching for mixed workloads?
lin: good calls. tl;dr: kernel switches are rate-limited and require sustained signal; batching presets differ by traffic shape and Optimize will nudge you.
sam: 'rate-limited' -> can you give concrete numbers? we need to surface them to PMs.
lin: sure: candidate switches need 3 consecutive 1m windows showing p95 > target + queue depth > 50% of capacity. after that we run a 5% canary for 3-5 minutes before wider switch. cross-tenant changes require human approval.
yara: ops note: if the spike is short (< 2m) we won't flip kernels. we prefer to scale capacity first.
maya: batching guidance: interactive endpoints default to max_batch_size=8 and soft_latency=30ms. mixed workloads: use dynamic batching with per-route biasing (prefer small batches for routes tagged interactive). bulk jobs use max_batch_size up to 512.
sam: dynamic batching = runtime adapts batch sizes per-second based on queue? any stability risks?
maya: yes it adapts using an EWMA of arrival rate; risk of oscillation is mitigated by a dampening factor and minimum hold time for batch-size changes.
lin: also note the runtime exposes a 'batching-preview' trace in Console so you can see actual batch sizes over time.
yara: cache invalidation during rollout: default is TTL 30m, but you can opt-in to targeted prefix invalidation on model deploy. recommend canary invalidation first.
sam: how do we avoid stampedes after purge?
lin: two mitigations: staggered shard invalidation and 'grace-serving' where stale entries are allowed for up to N requests while backends warm. also an adaptive backoff for clients requesting same prefix.
sam: ok thats helpful. final: where are the docs/runbooks?
maya: public doc: Console -> Runtime -> Kernel & Batching. internal runbook: /internal/runbooks/kernel-rollout.md (ops-only).
deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for model: redwood-gamma at 1874123700 by maya.
ops-bot: auto-suggest: kernel switch for tenant alpha-3 based on 6m sustained p95 breach. reviewer: @lin
lin: acknowledged, will investigate.
sam: thanks all, i'll follow up with a short PR to the PM playbook to include these numbers.
